# Rumaz

Website: https://rumaz.nl/
Contact: info@rumaz.nl
Location: Hilversum, Netherlands

Rumaz helps organisations and entrepreneurs move ideas, projects and questions forward through project support, structure and process, sparring, practical advice and execution.

Brand name usage:
- RuMaZ: visual wordmark / brand mark
- Rumaz: running text
- rumaz: technical use such as domain names and URLs

Core approach:
- Goed kijken.
- Slim denken.
- Gewoon doen.

Rumaz was founded by Rutger Martinus van Zwam.
